title: About Me
description: A Software Engineer who works across the full breadth of modern software — from SaaS products and large, interconnected systems to mobile and desktop apps. Strong background in automation and IT infrastructure, with a track record of designing solutions that scale and keep running with minimal hand-holding. Currently an Application Development Senior Specialist at Vodafone Oman, where I turn complex business problems into reliable, well-engineered systems.
